meta.name: decide
meta.description: Use when the user faces a real decision with stakes and wants it framed cleanly — options, ranked criteria, a recommendation, the falsifier, and reversibility — then logged to decisions/log.md. Trigger on "/decide", "help me decide", "should I X or Y", "frame this decision", "what's the call here", "log this decision".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把有风险的决策结构化记录到日志文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要做重要决策并希望留下清晰记录
copy.tagline_en: Structure and log high-stakes decisions to a file
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often make important decisions and want clear records

howto.what: 当你面临有后果的真实决策时，Claude 会帮你梳理选项、列出排序后的评判标准、给出推荐、指出如何判断决策错误（证伪条件），并说明决策是否可逆。最后，在你确认后，将决策记录到 decisions/log.md 文件中。
howto.when: 当你说出“/decide”、“help me decide”、“should I X or Y”、“frame this decision”、“what's the call here”、“log this decision”等触发词时，或当你面临有后果的真实选择（如权衡、招聘、供应商、方向、赌注）时触发。

say.text: 帮我决定是接受A公司offer还是B公司offer。
say.note: Claude 会按框架分析选项、标准、推荐等。

say.text: 我应该换工作还是留在现公司？
say.note: Claude 会列出选项、排序标准并给出推荐。

say.text: 记录这个决策：我们选择使用AWS而不是Azure。

howto.what_en: When you face a real decision with stakes, Claude helps frame options, ranked criteria, a recommendation, a falsifier (how you'd know you were wrong), and reversibility. After your confirmation, it logs the decision to decisions/log.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/decide", "help me decide", "should I X or Y", "frame this decision", "what's the call here", "log this decision", or when you face a real choice with stakes (tradeoff, hire, vendor, direction, bet).

say_en.text: Help me decide between job offer A and job offer B.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze options, criteria, recommendation, etc.

say_en.text: Should I switch jobs or stay at my current company?
say_en.note: Claude will list options, rank criteria, and recommend.

say_en.text: Log this decision: we choose AWS over Azure.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for confirmation then append to decisions/log.md.
